principle: The shell exposes durable public surfaces with simple navigation labels. Brand identities remain available inside each surface.
rules: Navigation labels are functional and concise; surface brand names appear within their destinations.
ONE and Doré Folio are exposed through Emmaus, never as peer first-level surfaces.
Magazine section Emmaus and surface Emmaus may share visible naming but retain distinct internal IDs.
Legacy Journal identifiers remain migration aliases only and must not be presented as the canonical public surface name.
Legacy paths may remain while migration is active, but the canonical shell must not advertise retired surfaces.
Surface navigation expresses presentation responsibility; it does not imply ownership of canonical resources.
Search is a utility consumer and remains last in the primary navigation.
